'''Fudbalski klub Sloboda Novi Grad''' ([[Serbian Cyrillic]]: Фудбалски клуб Cлoбoдa Hoви Гpaд) was a [[association football|football]] club from the town of [[Novi Grad, Republika Srpska|Bosanski Novi]], Republika Srpska, [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]], and one of the oldest in the country. The club competes in the [[First League of the Republika Srpska]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://sportsport.ba/fudbal/sloboda-iz-novog-grada-novistari-prvoligas/362260|title=Sloboda iz Novog Grada novi/stari prvoligaš|date=22 May 2020|access-date=22 May 2020|language=bs|author=A. Pašić|publisher=sportsport.ba}}</ref>"}}
